program.heading: Earn as an agent with <brand>RizqifyBD</brand>
program.description: Join as an agent (reseller) and earn attractive commission on every successful sale. Read the rules below and apply today.
program.loadFailedBody: There was a problem fetching information from the server.

info.whyDescription: Start your reseller journey with a single application.

rules.title: Programme rules
rules.description: Know the rules before you apply.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.description: What you need in order to apply.

benefits.title: Benefits & commission
benefits.description: What you get as an agent.

rulesItems: Only one agent application can be submitted per account.
Fake, multiple or self-referral sales are not accepted.
An approved application is required for agent benefits to activate.
Even after approval your account stays a customer account — only the agent badge and reseller benefits are added.
Benefits may be removed if a breach of the rules is proven.
eligibilityItems: You must have an active and verified RizqifyBD customer account.
The account must not be suspended or deleted.
You must agree to the programme's terms and conditions.
Sales and promotion must be conducted honestly and transparently.
Benefits continue as long as you keep actively selling.
benefitsItems: Attractive commission on every successful sale.
Commission goes straight to your wallet — easy to withdraw.
An agent (reseller) badge on your profile and dashboard.
Full tracking and reports from your dashboard.

status.canEarn: Your agent benefits and commission are active — commission from new sales will be credited to your wallet.
status.notEarning: Your agent benefits are being processed — they'll be active soon.
status.singleApplication: Only one application is accepted per account, so you can't apply again until a decision is final.
status.pendingNote: Your account stays a normal customer until approval — the agent badge and reseller benefits are added afterwards.

program.heading: Earn by referring with <brand>RizqifyBD</brand>
program.description: Invite your contacts to RizqifyBD and earn attractive income for every successful referral. Read the rules below and apply today.
program.loadFailedBody: There was a problem fetching information from the server.

info.whyDescription: Begin your referral journey with a single application.

rules.title: Programme rules
rules.description: Know the rules before joining the programme.

benefits.title: Benefits & income
benefits.description: What you get from the referral programme.

rulesItems: Only one referral application can be submitted per account.
Fake, duplicate or self-referrals are not accepted.
Referral income only activates once your application is approved.
When the conditions are met, referral income is added straight to your wallet.
Breaking the rules may result in removal from the programme.
eligibilityItems: You must have an active and verified RizqifyBD customer account.
Your account must not be banned or deleted.
You must accept the programme's terms and conditions.
You must promote the platform honestly and transparently.
Eligibility is maintained with regular active referrals.
benefitsItems: Attractive income for every successful referral.
Income straight to your wallet — easy to withdraw.
Full tracking and reports from your dashboard.
A fully secure, transparent and verified process.
